newsitem.title: USA: ModaCAD licenses system to Woolworth Canada.
newsitem.headline: ModaCAD licenses system to Woolworth Canada.

text.p: LOS ANGELES, May 2 (Reuter) ModaCAD Inc on Friday said Woolworth Corp's Canadian operator, Woolworth Canada Inc, has licensed ModaCAD's Design System for use by its Weekend Edition and Randy River clothing divisions.
Financial details of this agreement were not disclosed.

Design System is a computer automated design (CAD) product through which companies to streamline product development and merchandise cycles. It create "virtual samples" that allow product makers to circumvent prototype and sample production.
The agreement follows an earlier license Woolworth Canada's Northern Group of stores.
